about: SORT (ADR-0125): an array ordered by one of its columns or rows; it spills.

cases.description: By the first column, ascending, when nothing more is given
by_col sorts the columns by a row
An index past the array is #VALUE!
An order other than 1 and -1 is #VALUE!
Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: text sorts without regard to case
Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: numbers sort before text, and text before booleans
Engine's refusal: a blank key is #VALUE!. Excel's Anchor shows 7, so the blank does not sort first as 0; where it goes, what its spilled cell shows and how a descending sort places it were not read
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0202, ADR-0047: a blank among SORT's keys is refused with #VALUE! until Excel is asked where it sorts; the seventeenth Windows run read only the Anchor (7), and following it would guess the rest

cases.description: Refused until Excel is asked: what the blank key's spilled cell shows below the 7 of SORT-011 (0, or empty text)
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0202, ADR-0047: a blank among SORT's keys is refused with #VALUE! until Excel is asked where it sorts; recorded, so that a run reads Excel's answer

cases.description: Refused until Excel is asked: a blank key in a descending sort (7 first if a blank sorts last whatever the order)
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0202, ADR-0047: a blank among SORT's keys is refused with #VALUE! until Excel is asked where it sorts; recorded, so that a run reads Excel's answer

cases.description: Refused until Excel is asked: a blank key among text (a first if a blank sorts last, not as empty text)
